title: Stop aborts a bench model call and prevents another retry while keeping an uncertain receipt
steps: S1: start a scripted model call that remains in flight, then abort its bench signal.
S2: start a scripted model that returns a retryable 429, then abort during backoff before the next attempt.
S3: set the bench's durable Stop flag while its watcher is running.
expect: S1: AGENT_ABORTED ends the call, the turn has a failed uncertain receipt, one request was dispatched, and resume does not replay it.
S2: AGENT_ABORTED ends the backoff, the failed attempt stays on the receipt, and no second request is dispatched.
S3: the watcher observes the Stop flag and aborts the active signal.
evidence: The shared bench loop previously read cancellation only after an answered model turn, leaving an in-flight request running until its call timeout.
fence: An interrupted provider call is never silently replayed, and cancellation cannot dispatch another retry attempt.

tests: an abort during a model call saves an uncertain receipt and never retries it
Stop during retry backoff dispatches no second call and keeps the failed attempt
the bench Stop watcher aborts the active signal when the durable Stop flag is set
